author: Draper
description: Keeps the music going by queueing YouTube's recommended tracks (YouTube Mix / radio) when the queue runs empty. Unlike PyLav's built-in autoplay, the next track is seeded from whatever just finished playing rather than picked at random from a fixed playlist.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild settings and a short in-memory list of recently played track identifiers. Nothing is persisted about individual users.
install_msg:
Enable it per server with `[p]ytradio toggle true`.
Requires a Lavalink node with a working YouTube source manager.
name: PyLavYouTubeRadio
